scope.domain: All finite environment trees with arbitrary finite byte atoms, including malformed strict argument lists.
scope.claim: The extracted strict two-atom Boolean IR accepts exactly the independent ABI and returns byte inequality in the structural model.

extraction.standard_library: Trusts the installed pinned compiler/standard library and primitive bridge; no preservation theorem.
extraction.portable_record: Machine-specific driver digest/full compiler identity were checked against fresh local Cargo manifests; recorded inputs below identify source, not a binary attestation.

source_lineage.scope: Exact Cargo source lineage for four deliberate negative controls and one positive equivalence control. No compilation, solver execution or compiler-preservation result is asserted by this manifest.

native_cli.stdout: JSON Boolean literal plus LF on successful invocation; no stdout on argument/variant/hex errors.
native_cli.scope: Actual exported function call over validated atom payloads; this host CLI does not parse or validate an outer CLVM environment.

controls.operation: Replace only the != expression with ==; preserve the strict two-slice signature.

patch.text:
--- a/puzzles/atom-not-equal/puzzle.rs
+++ b/experiments/byte-proofs/src/operator_eq.rs
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 #[chialisp_oxide::puzzle]
 pub fn puzzle(left: &[u8], right: &[u8]) -> bool {
-    left != right
+    left == right
 }

controls.operation: Replace the right operand with left. The local unused-variable and eq_op allows are intentional non-policy annotations.

patch.text:
--- a/puzzles/atom-not-equal/puzzle.rs
+++ b/experiments/byte-proofs/src/self_inequality.rs
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
+#[allow(unused_variables, clippy::eq_op)]
 #[chialisp_oxide::puzzle]
 pub fn puzzle(left: &[u8], right: &[u8]) -> bool {
-    left != right
+    left != left
 }
